entities.summary: Victoria Zdrok Wilson is an American pornographic film actress, author, and model. She was Playboy's Playmate for October 1994. In June 2002 she became Penthouse magazine's Pet of the Month, and was later chosen as their 2004 Penthouse Pet of the Year. Zdrok is also a non-practicing attorney, as well as a clinical psychologist and sex therapist.
